refnamediv.refpurpose: Restores a previously unregistered built-in wrapper

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.returnvalues;
&return.success; &true; is also returned, with an E_NOTICE, if the wrapper was never changed. &false; is returned, with an E_WARNING, if protocol is not the name of a built-in wrapper, for example a wrapper that only exists as a user-defined one, a name in the wrong case, or an empty string.
